title: 第二十五章 挺身而出第二十六章 中人
lines: 乔执中变脸，这典型就是你和他讲道理，他和你耍流氓，你和他耍流氓，他又要和你讲道理，只是这一变化，将其外强中干的本性暴露无遗。
姚云生的气势一下就上来了，他也是纨绔，欺软怕硬也是他的专业。今日乔执中倘若仗着武力，硬要将县衙扫平，他肯定认怂。
可是乔执中前倨后恭，先认怂了，那对不起，别怪他姚云生得寸进尺，今日是他姚云生的主场，凡事得听他的！
当即他道：“好啊，本县岂是不尽人情之人？来人啊，那姓武的小儿现在在何处啊？”
有衙役禀报道：“回禀县尊，县尊刚刚下令让魏县尉打他二十杀威棒，此时应该正在行刑呢！”
周围众人一片哗然，姚云生竟然敢先打武攸敏二十杀威棒？百姓们心中那个高兴啊，都觉得大快人心，岂能不轰然叫好？
而乔执中一行人则是个个脸色大变，偏偏他们认怂在前，气势已经被压住了，再要翻脸便胆怯了。
姚云生哈哈大笑，道：“走，都去看看，看这杀威棒打得如何？”
姚云生领着众人，还有很多百姓也都蜂蛹而动，大家齐齐奔县衙的后院。大唐的建筑以大为美，县衙后院十分空旷，打杀威棒的地方便在演武场的正中央。
县尉魏生明领着燕二等几人正在行刑，姚云生放狠话在前，魏生明虽然心中叫苦，却也不敢完全阳奉阴违，在棒子上稍微加了点力气。
只是武攸敏何许人也？一个被酒色掏空，手无缚鸡之力的纨绔，哪里吃得消？一顿杀威棒打下来，真是哭爹喊娘，场面凄惨得狠！
姚云生领着众人到演武场的时候，恰是杀威棒打得最猛的时候，行刑的衙役眼睛的余光看到了县尊大人亲临，他哪里还敢偷懒，这两棒真是打得格外卖力。
武攸敏鬼哭狼嚎，骂道：“姓魏的，我武攸敏记住了，这件事儿了了，看我怎么找你算账！
还有姓燕的狗奴才，你口蜜腹剑，表面上客气，却在暗中阴我，我武攸敏和你也和你没完！还有合宫县衙，你们这帮狗|杂毛，我要将你们全踩死……”
魏生明听得是心惊肉跳，脸色都白了，偷鸡不成蚀把米，他魏生明真就是自作自受，他找来武攸敏，是想着在县衙里面使坏，让自己重夺权柄的！
没有想到事情竟然失控到了这种地步，姚云生在东都提前回来也就罢了，而且还和武攸敏卯上了，两人谁都不服谁，斗起了法。
两位贵人斗法，他这种人夹在中间还不成肉夹馍？他心中苦啊，可是没有办法，这事儿到了这一步，他真不知道该怎么收场了……
姚云生，乔执中一行人到了现场，武攸敏一眼看到了乔执中，像是缺水的禾苗遇到了甘霖，一双眼睛倏然变得锃亮。
他大声道：“乔管家，您快救我啊！你瞅瞅这帮家伙，藐视我们武家，你让我们本家大哥带一彪人马过来，直接平了这地方，一定要平了这地方……”
乔执中一头的黑线，他扫了一眼武攸敏的伤势，心中瞬间转过很多念头，关于武攸敏惹事的前因后果他大抵都清楚了，按照大唐律令，武攸敏自然是罪有应得！
眼下到了合宫县的地盘上，周围又有这么多人围着，事情不太好办。
当即他道：“县尊大人，吾来合宫县之前，武丞相专门对吾有吩咐，关于这几点吩咐，我还想借一步和您细说！”
他微微顿了顿，环顾四周，声音倏然拔高，道：“各位，尔等今天都要想好了！我武家真的值得尔等如此痛恨，如此对待么？
武家是天后老人家的本家，大唐的江山是天后在替陛下打理，尔等对我武家如此痛恨，是不是因为尔等要借题发挥，对天后她老人家有异议？
都给我听好了，今日已经过去的事情我既往不咎，但接下来尔等倘若还是这般行事，我乔某定会将尔等一一记下，回头我会亲自问一问，看看你们究竟是有何居心？”
好个乔执中，果然老奸巨猾，关键时候他使出了杀手锏，对县衙里的众人直接分化。县令姚云生来历不凡，背景强大，他乔执中认怂不惹。
但是其他人他直接出言威胁，拿出了武家压人，简单、粗暴、直接，他这一发威，全场雅雀无声，个个噤若寒蝉。
武家惹不起啊……
人群中，沉默的强子使劲的攥了攥拳头，姚云生环顾四周，发现周围的众人，魏生明，傅游艺，周柔等全被镇住了。
他心里不由得虚了起来，下意识他将目光投向了岳峰。姚云生骨子里只是个欺软怕硬的纨绔，心中的主意不多，自然比不得乔执中老奸巨猾。
今天这事儿，走到了这一步，姚云生该出的气也出了！如果再继续下去，那真就要和武家翻脸了。
和武家翻脸，他姚云生可能立马就要成为孤家寡人，因为现场这么多人，除了他姚云生之外，谁敢得罪武家？
形势如此突变姚云生现在该怎么办？立马认怂放人？他面子往哪里搁？可是不放人就要翻脸，后果他能承受？
岳峰深深的吐了一口气，他的身后，朱恩道：“岳大哥，武家势大，不是我们兄弟能惹得起的啊！”
“岳大哥义气我们都知道，但是，您不为自己想，也要为家里的大哥想，为您的母亲想，你说是不是？”
岳峰微微皱眉，他的目光扫向身边的众人，所有人都看着他，每个人都紧张得很，他们紧张什么？
当然是紧张岳峰在这个时候站出去，乔执中放出了话来，岳峰还要说话，那不是和武家作对是什么？
岳峰的目光最后落在了强子身上，强子和岳峰四目对视，他迅速低头跪在了地上，朱恩道：“强子传话给我，说兄弟们已经尽力，首领您已经尽力，他感激不尽！让首领再别冲动了。”
岳峰用舌头舔了舔嘴唇，胸口忽地似乎被什么东西给堵住了，他的目光再一次挪开，恰在这时候，他看到了武攸敏，这小子一脸的怨毒，和岳峰四目对视，眼神中尽是挑衅和不屑……
岳峰胸口被堵住的那一团瞬间的炸开，一股热血升腾而起，直冲头顶，他迅速扭头看向姚云生，然后上前迈出一步道：
“县尊大人，武公子自称善蹴鞠，其来我合宫县不就是仰县尊大人的蹴鞠之技而来么？”
content_en:
Qiao Zhizhong's change of attitude is a typical example of you trying to reason with him and him being a gangster with you, and you and him being a gangster, and he trying to reason with you again, but this change fully exposed his nature of being strong on the outside but hard on the inside.
Yao Yunsheng's momentum rose immediately. He was also a playboy, and bullying the weak and fearing the strong was also his specialty. Today, if Qiao Zhizhong insists on wiping out the county government by force, he will definitely give in.
But Qiao Zhizhong, who was arrogant at first and respectful at the end, gave in first. I'm sorry, don't blame him, Yao Yunsheng, for pushing his limits. Today is Yao Yunsheng's home court, so you have to listen to him in everything!
He immediately said: "Okay, aren't the people in this county so unkind? Come on, where is the boy named Wu now?"
A yamen servant reported: "Reporting to the county magistrate, the county magistrate has just ordered Wei County Lieutenant to beat him with twenty kills with a powerful stick. The execution should be in progress at this time!"
"Coax!"
Everyone around was in an uproar. Yao Yunsheng dared to hit Wu Youmin with the twenty-kill stick first? The joy in the hearts of the people, they all felt so happy, how could they not cheer loudly?
As for Qiao Zhizhong and the others, their expressions changed drastically. However, they gave in and were too timid to rebel. Their momentum had already been suppressed.
Yao Yunsheng laughed loudly and said, "Let's go and have a look. How does this killing stick perform?"
Yao Yunsheng led the crowd, and many people also rushed to the backyard of the county government office. The buildings of the Tang Dynasty were beautiful because of their large size. The backyard of the county government office was very open, and the place for killing and killing people was right in the middle of the martial arts field.
County Lieutenant Wei Shengming, leading Yan Er and others, were executing the execution. Yao Yunsheng spoke harsh words in front of him. Although Wei Shengming was complaining in his heart, he did not dare to completely follow the rules and put a little more force on the stick.
But who is Wu Youmin? How can a dandy, who has been hollowed out by wine and sex and has no power to restrain a chicken, endure? After being beaten down with a killing stick, I was really crying for my father and mother. The scene was so miserable!
When Yao Yunsheng led everyone to the martial arts arena, it was when the killing sticks were hitting the hardest. The executioner's Yamen saw the county magistrate coming in person out of the corner of his eye. How could he dare to be lazy? The two sticks were really powerful.
Wu Youmin cried like a ghost and howled like a wolf, and cursed: "My surname is Wei, I, Wu Youmin, remember it. It's over now. Let's see how I can settle the score with you!"
There is also the dog slave named Yan. You talk sweetly and are polite on the surface, but you are secretly plotting against me. I, Wu Youmin, and you are not done with you either! And the Hegong County Government Office, you bunch of dogs | bastards, I will trample you all to death..."
Wei Shengming was frightened when he heard this, and his face turned pale. He stole the chicken but lost the rice. Wei Shengming really brought it upon himself. He found Wu Youmin because he wanted to cause trouble in the county government and let himself regain power!
Unexpectedly, things got out of control to this extent. Yao Yunsheng came back early from Dongdu, and even got into a fight with Wu Youmin. The two of them refused to accept the other and started fighting.
When two noble men are fighting for their wits, how can a man like him be caught in the middle? He felt bitter in his heart, but he had no choice. When the matter reached this point, he really didn't know how to end it...
Yao Yunsheng, Qiao Zhizhong and their entourage arrived at the scene. Wu Youmin saw Qiao Zhizhong at a glance, like water-deficient seedlings encountering sweet rain, and his eyes suddenly became bright.
He said loudly: "Steward Qiao, please save me! Look at these guys, they despise our Wu family. You ask our eldest brother to bring a group of people over and level this place directly. We must level this place..."
Qiao held the black thread at one end. He glanced at Wu Youmin's injuries, and many thoughts flashed through his mind. He generally knew the causes and consequences of Wu Youmin's trouble. According to the laws of the Tang Dynasty, Wu Youmin certainly deserved what he deserved!
Now that we are on the territory of Hegong County, and there are so many people surrounding us, things are not easy to handle.
He immediately said: "Your Excellency, before I came to Hegong County, Prime Minister Wu gave me special instructions. I would like to take a step to explain these instructions to you in detail!"
He paused slightly, looked around, and said in a loud voice, "Everyone, you have to think about it today! Is my Wu family really worthy of your hatred and treatment?
The Wu family is the main family of the Queen of Heaven, and the Queen of the Tang Dynasty is taking care of the country for Your Majesty. Is it because you hate the Wu family so much because you want to make use of the topic and have objections to the Queen of Heaven?
Listen to me, I will let go of what happened today, but if you still behave like this in the future, I, Qiao, will definitely write you down one by one, and I will ask you personally later to see what your intentions are? "
Qiao Zhizhong turned out to be cunning and cunning. At the critical moment, he used his trump card to divide everyone in the county government. The county magistrate Yao Yunsheng has an extraordinary background and a powerful background. He is a coward and will not be messed with.
But he directly threatened others and used the Wu family to suppress them. It was simple, rude, and direct. His display of power silenced the entire audience, and everyone was as silent as a chill.
The Wu family can't afford to offend...
In the crowd, the silent Qiangzi clenched his fists hard. Yao Yunsheng looked around and found that everyone around him, including Wei Shengming, Fu Youyi, Zhou Rou, etc., were all suppressed.
He couldn't help but feel weak, and subconsciously turned his attention to Yue Feng. At his core, Yao Yunsheng is just a playboy who bullies the weak and fears the strong. He doesn't have many ideas in his heart, so he is naturally not as cunning as Qiao Zhizhong.
Today's matter has come to this point, and Yao Yunsheng has become angry! If he continues, he will really fall out with the Wu family.
After falling out with the Wu family, he, Yao Yunsheng, might soon become a loner. Because there were so many people present, who would dare to offend the Wu family except him, Yao Yunsheng?
What should Yao Yunsheng do now when the situation has changed so suddenly? Give up immediately and let him go? Where should he put his face? But if he doesn't let him go, he will fall out. Can he bear the consequences?
Yue Feng took a deep breath. Behind him, Zhu En said: "Brother Yue, the Wu family is so powerful that we brothers cannot afford to offend him!"
"We all know how loyal Brother Yue is, but if you don't think about yourself, you should also think about your eldest brother in the family and your mother, don't you think so?"
Yue Feng frowned slightly and glanced at the people around him. Everyone was looking at him. Everyone was very nervous. Why were they nervous?
Of course, he was nervous that Yue Feng would step forward at this time, Qiao Zhizhong said something, and Yue Feng still wanted to speak. What if he wasn't going against the Wu family?
Yue Feng's eyes finally fell on Qiangzi. Qiangzi and Yue Feng looked at each other. He quickly lowered his head and knelt on the ground. Zhu En said: "Qiangzi sent me a message saying that the brothers have tried their best. You, the leader, have tried your best. He is grateful! Let the leader stop being impulsive."
Yue Feng licked his lips with his tongue. His chest suddenly seemed to be blocked by something. He looked away again. At this moment, he saw Wu Youmin. This kid had a look of resentment on his face. He looked at Yue Feng with eyes full of provocation and disdain...
The blockage on Yue Feng's chest exploded instantly, and a burst of hot blood rose up and went straight to the top of his head. He quickly turned to look at Yao Yunsheng, then took a step forward and said:
"Your Excellency, Mr. Wu claims to be good at Cuju. Didn't he come to Hegong County just to admire your skills at Cuju?"
title_en: Chapter 25: Stand Up Chapter 26: The Killer
